## Context
InkOS S21 Track B. New migration for the `stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status` RPC.

## File to create
`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/supabase/migrations/20260513100000_payments_l2_dispute_defense_pack_status.sql`

## What this migration does

Add one RPC: `stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(p_dispute_id text, p_status text, p_bundle_url text, p_submitted_at timestamptz)`.

This updates `stripe_disputes.defense_pack_status` + `defense_pack_url` + optionally `submitted_at` (not currently a column — check if column exists).

Looking at the existing `stripe_disputes` schema (from `20260505100000_payments_l2_stripe_connect_schema.sql`):
- `defense_pack_status` — text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK IN ('pending','assembling','ready','submitted','failed')
- `defense_pack_url` — text NULL

There is NO `submitted_at` column. So the RPC will update `defense_pack_status` and `defense_pack_url` only.

**Migration adds:**
1. Column `submitted_at timestamptz NULL` to `stripe_disputes` (we need to track submission time)
2. RPC `stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status`

## RPC spec

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(
  p_dispute_id   text,
  p_status       text,
  p_bundle_url   text,
  p_submitted_at timestamptz
) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_id uuid;
  v_current_status text;
BEGIN
  SELECT id, defense_pack_status
  INTO v_id, v_current_status
  FROM stripe_disputes
  WHERE dispute_id = p_dispute_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'stripe_dispute not found: %', p_dispute_id;
  END IF;

  -- Idempotency: if already at target status, return existing row
  IF v_current_status = p_status THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', v_id::text, 'defense_pack_status', v_current_status, 'created', false);
  END IF;

  UPDATE stripe_disputes
  SET
    defense_pack_status = p_status,
    defense_pack_url    = COALESCE(p_bundle_url, defense_pack_url),
    submitted_at        = COALESCE(p_submitted_at, submitted_at),
    updated_at          = now()
  WHERE dispute_id = p_dispute_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', v_id::text, 'defense_pack_status', p_status, 'created', true);
END;
$$;
```

**CC48 check:** Return keys are `id`, `defense_pack_status`, `created` — must exactly match `StripeDisputeSetDefensePackStatusResult` from `lib/payments/contracts.ts`. The contract has:
```typescript
type StripeDisputeSetDefensePackStatusResult = {
  id: string;
  defense_pack_status: DisputeDefensePackStatus;
};
```
So the return object must have `id` (text/string) and `defense_pack_status`. The `created` boolean is extra info (safe to include). Good.

**Security:**
- `SECURITY DEFINER` + `SET search_path = public`
- `REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(text,text,text,timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;`
- `REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(text,text,text,timestamptz) FROM authenticated;`
- `GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(text,text,text,timestamptz) TO service_role;`

**DOWN section:**
```sql
ALTER TABLE stripe_disputes DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS submitted_at;
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(text, text, text, timestamptz) CASCADE;
```

Also check: does `stripe_disputes` have `updated_at` column? Check the S13 migration. If not, remove `updated_at = now()` from the UPDATE. Read the S13 migration first:
`grep -n "updated_at\|stripe_disputes" /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq\ App/InkOS/supabase/migrations/20260505100000_payments_l2_stripe_connect_schema.sql | head -20`

Write the migration file now.

-- SECTION 4 — TABLE: stripe_disputes
--
-- Mirrors Stripe dispute objects. Defense pack assembled async by BullMQ worker.
-- charge_id TEXT (ch_xxx) — FK to stripe_charges.charge_id (Stripe ID, not UUID).
-- UNIQUE (dispute_id) — one dispute per Stripe dp_xxx.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stripe_disputes (
  id                    uuid        NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  studio_id             uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  dispute_id            text        NOT NULL,        -- dp_xxx
  charge_id             text        NOT NULL,        -- ch_xxx → stripe_charges.charge_id
  reason                text        NOT NULL,        -- Stripe reason code
  status                text        NOT NULL
                                    CHECK (status IN (
                                      'warning_needs_response',
                                      'warning_under_review',
                                      'warning_closed',
                                      'needs_response',
                                      'under_review',
                                      'won',
                                      'lost',
                                      'charge_refunded'
                                    )),
  amount_cents          bigint      NOT NULL,
  currency              text        NOT NULL
                                    CHECK (currency IN ('usd', 'gbp', 'eur', 'aud', 'cad')),
  evidence_due_by       timestamptz NOT NULL,        -- submit 24h before this
  defense_pack_status   text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                                    CHECK (defense_pack_status IN (
                                      'pending', 'assembling', 'ready', 'submitted', 'failed'
                                    )),
  defense_pack_url      text        NULL,            -- signed Storage URL of bundle PDF
  submitted_at          timestamptz NULL,
  resolved_at           timestamptz NULL,
  resolved_amount_cents bigint      NULL,            -- clawback amount if lost
  created_at            timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  CONSTRAINT stripe_disputes_pkey           PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT stripe_disputes_dispute_id_key UNIQUE (dispute_id),
  CONSTRAINT stripe_disputes_amount_pos     CHECK (amount_cents > 0)
);

COMMENT ON TABLE  stripe_disputes IS 'L2 S13 — Mirrors Stripe dispute objects. Defense pack assembled async by BullMQ worker. Webhook-only writes.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN stripe_disputes.charge_id IS 'ch_xxx — Stripe charge ID. Lookup via stripe_charges.charge_id (text), not the UUID id.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN stripe_disputes.evidence_due_by IS 'Submit defense pack 24 hours before this timestamp. Cron queries: WHERE status IN (''needs_response'') AND evidence_due_by > now() - interval ''24 hours''.';

-- RLS
ALTER TABLE stripe_disputes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "stripe_disputes_select_studio_admin"
  ON stripe_disputes
  FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (
    studio_id IN (
      SELECT studio_id FROM studio_members
      WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
        AND role IN ('owner', 'admin')
        AND deactivated_at IS NULL
    )
  );

-- No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE for authenticated — service_role RPCs only

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stripe_disputes_studio_id
  ON stripe_disputes (studio_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stripe_disputes_dispute_id
  ON stripe_disputes (dispute_id);              -- covers UNIQUE + webhook lookup

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stripe_disputes_charge_id
  ON stripe_disputes (charge_id);              -- join to stripe_charges.charge_id

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_stripe_disputes_status_evidence_due_by
  ON stripe_disputes (status, evidence_due_by); -- assemble cron: urgent disputes

-- =============================================================================
-- MIGRATION: 20260513100000_payments_l2_dispute_defense_pack_status
-- Sprint 21 Track B — Stripe L2 Marketplace: dispute defense pack status RPC
--
-- WHAT:
--   Adds RPC stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status to update defense_pack_status,
--   defense_pack_url, and submitted_at on stripe_disputes. Called exclusively by
--   the BullMQ DisputeDefenseAssembler worker (service_role only).
--
-- NOTES:
--   - stripe_disputes.submitted_at and defense_pack_url already exist (S13).
--   - stripe_disputes has NO updated_at column — not touched here.
--   - Idempotent: returns {created: false} if row is already at target status.
--   - SECURITY DEFINER locked to service_role — authenticated cannot call this.
--
-- ROLLBACK (DOWN):
--   DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(text, text, text, timestamptz) CASCADE;
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- SECTION 1 — RPC: stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(
  p_dispute_id   text,
  p_status       text,
  p_bundle_url   text,
  p_submitted_at timestamptz
) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_id             uuid;
  v_current_status text;
BEGIN
  -- Validate p_status against the defense_pack_status CHECK constraint values
  IF p_status NOT IN ('pending', 'assembling', 'ready', 'submitted', 'failed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid defense_pack_status value: %. Must be one of pending, assembling, ready, submitted, failed.', p_status;
  END IF;

  SELECT id, defense_pack_status
  INTO   v_id, v_current_status
  FROM   stripe_disputes
  WHERE  dispute_id = p_dispute_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'stripe_dispute not found: %', p_dispute_id;
  END IF;

  -- Idempotency: already at target status — return without writing
  IF v_current_status = p_status THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'id',                  v_id::text,
      'defense_pack_status', v_current_status,
      'created',             false
    );
  END IF;

  UPDATE stripe_disputes
  SET
    defense_pack_status = p_status,
    defense_pack_url    = COALESCE(p_bundle_url,   defense_pack_url),
    submitted_at        = COALESCE(p_submitted_at, submitted_at)
  WHERE dispute_id = p_dispute_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id',                  v_id::text,
    'defense_pack_status', p_status,
    'created',             true
  );
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(text, text, text, timestamptz) IS
  'L2 S21 — Updates defense_pack_status, defense_pack_url, and submitted_at on stripe_disputes. '
  'Idempotent: no-op if row is already at the target status. '
  'service_role only — called by BullMQ DisputeDefenseAssembler worker. '
  'CC48 return keys match StripeDisputeSetDefensePackStatusResult in lib/payments/contracts.ts.';

-- =============================================================================
-- SECTION 2 — Permissions (service_role only)
-- =============================================================================

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(text, text, text, timestamptz) FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(text, text, text, timestamptz) FROM authenticated;
GRANT  EXECUTE ON FUNCTION stripe_dispute_set_defense_pack_status(text, text, text, timestamptz) TO service_role;

Two findings from reading the S13 migration that changed the spec:

1. `submitted_at timestamptz NULL` already exists on `stripe_disputes` — the ADD COLUMN step was dropped.
2. `stripe_disputes` has no `updated_at` column — the `updated_at = now()` line was removed from the UPDATE statement.

The RPC is otherwise exactly as specced: `SECURITY DEFINER`, `SET search_path = public`, status-enum guard before the lookup, idempotent early-return on matching status, `COALESCE` on both nullable fields, and permissions locked to `service_role` only.
